name: waynestate/sourdough
description: A starter that makes a Wayne State app with the stack already wired in.

scripts-descriptions.ci: The full CI gate: validate, tests, Pint, PHPStan, Squire copy check, agent-ready files, audit. Same command on GitLab and GitHub.
scripts-descriptions.squire-copy:sync: Rewrite templates/squire/ from the installed SQUIRE package (vendor/waynestate/squire). Run it when SQUIRE moves on, then commit the result.
scripts-descriptions.squire-copy:check: Check that templates/squire/ still matches a fresh export from the installed SQUIRE package (vendor/waynestate/squire). Exits 1 on drift; exits 2 when the package is not installed.
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
